models.selection: All 800 original visible normal-mode meshes. The 2690 hidden meshes are alternate studies/groups; two points are excluded. Stable object IDs are recorded. No spatial crop or inferred assembly.
models.credit: JosHsuan Chao / National Cheng Kung University studio study.
models.representation: Study model of the rotary-cut assembly. Drag to inspect the simulated units.

processing.method: Original stored mesh positions and faces converted once to the verified web coordinate convention; no procedural replacement.

models.selection: All 2245 original visible normal-mode Breps: 600 panels, 1620 fixings, 23 pipes and two original Layer 02 column/base solids. Exactly 600 Text and six DimLinear objects are excluded. No spatial crop, hidden replacement or inferred assembly. Original scheme CAD, not certification of the final built installation.
models.credit: PKD Engineering Consultants project team; scheme modelling and fabrication-drawing work by JosHsuan Chao.
models.representation: Scheme model of the folded-panel installation, with its connections, supports, core and base.

processing.method: Original stored mesh positions and faces converted once to the verified web coordinate convention; no procedural replacement.

models.selection: Every velocity=2 record, selected by recorded explicit field rather than bounding box; 14810 original path sample points. This is not an inferred finished solid.
models.credit: MAS DFab Group 1 / JosHsuan Chao, Namdev Talluru and JunJie. Individual path-code authorship is not assigned.
models.representation: Recorded low-speed dot-path sample positions from Group 1. This point study describes the path rather than a finished solid.

processing.method: Original velocity=2 sample positions converted once to web coordinates; native point primitive, no reconstructed surface.

models.selection: Original visible Lamp_mesh.001, the complete patterned lamp shade; source object name selected, no spatial crop. Surrounding architecture, props, fog, other lamp placements and lighting are excluded. This geometry display is not a caustics solver.
models.credit: Group-Red / Paul Jaeggi, Behnur Baiju, Kevin Seav and JosHsuan Chao.
models.representation: Original patterned lamp-shade model from the lighting study. The photographed light patterns remain the project evidence.

geometry.sourceUnits: meters in the original Blender scene; authored object transform retained

processing.method: Original complete shade exported by Blender 4.0.2 glTF exporter; original node transform, normal/UV seams and exported material retained. Exact raw buffer compression. The original procedural shader and IOR graph are not equivalent to the glTF material; this is not a new optical simulation.
